materialDelivery: Exactly assigned serialized payload injected into each model prompt; not tool retrieval or understanding.

setup.costMeaning: No paid API credit purchase or subscription upgrade. CPU/storage/energy value not measured; no claim of zero total cost or savings.

decision: Local model invocation and bounded evaluation now work. This developmental matrix is not evidence of novel-task transfer or incremental DXP operations. If both small models fail all acceptances, the pilot has a capability floor and cannot distinguish memory benefits.
nextGate: Improve model/task capability on unscored development work, implement actual controlled DXP/Git/flat operations, then freeze a separate unseen task matrix before confirmatory outputs.
limitations: Two small quantized open models, no frontier-provider comparison.
